name: v1.0.21 — Fix Game Crashes & Background Game Protection
body:
## 🌸 Kids OS v1.0.21 Release Notes

### 🎮 Game Crash Fixes & Protection
- **Resolved Leaked Back-Press on SystemUI**: Removed erroneous `GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK` call inside `MelodyGlobalService` when fullscreen immersive games trigger system bar adjustments, preventing games from being kicked back to launcher on launch.
- **Strict Scope for In-App Purchase Blocker**: Constrained purchase UI scanning exclusively to `com.android.vending` window hierarchy. Eliminated inadvertent scanning during `com.google.android.gms` events that previously misidentified in-game upgrade buttons (e.g. Angry Birds, Subway Surfers, Garden Mania) as Play Store dialogs and dismissed them.
- **Protected Google Services & Store Processes**: Added `com.google.android.gms` and `com.android.vending` to `DeviceBooster` protected processes so cloud saves, Google Play Games sign-in, and game initialization threads are never killed.
- **Storage Permissions Provisioned**: Automatically verified and provisioned runtime storage permissions across all installed game titles.
